description: TRELLIS.2 material stage at resolution 1024 conditioned on the geometry and the dataset render of the baked asset; voxel materials baked into the original UV layout (baselines/unguided_trellis2.py).
dataset: JonathanSickert/unbake: 10 objects x 8 baked HDR lightings = 80 inputs; subset 1 / subset 2 are two disjoint sets of 10 inputs with every object once

evaluation.uv: MAE / PSNR per channel against the ground-truth PBR maps on the texels covered by the UV layout; base color in sRGB, all values in [0, 1] (baselines/evaluate_uv.py)
evaluation.relit: prediction and ground truth rendered with the TRELLIS.2 PBR renderer under the 7 environment maps of env_maps/ that differ from the input's bake lighting, 4 views at 512x512; MAE / PSNR on object pixels, SSIM / LPIPS on the full image (baselines/evaluate_relit.py)
